reference.code: const nums=(s:string):number[]|null=>{if(!s)return null;let o:number[]=[];for(const z of s.split(',')){if(!/^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(z))return null;let x=Number(z);if(x< -1000||x>1000)return null;o.push(x)}return o};export function bandClamp(s:string):string|null{let p=s.split(';');if(p.length!==3)return null;let l=nums(p[0]),h=nums(p[1]),a=nums(p[2]);if(!l||!h||!a||l.length!==1||h.length!==1||l[0]>h[0])return null;let lo=l[0],hi=h[0];return a.map(x=>Math.min(hi,Math.max(lo,x))).join(',')}
